Fundada em 1987 como uma pequena boutique de camisas, somos uma marca carioca reconhecida por seu cuidado com o produto. Atemporais, sofisticadas e descomplicadas. O exclusivo Azul Aviator, materializado no painel de azulejos e em detalhes surpreendentes na decoração, dá assinatura à marca e personaliza o ambiente. Fazer parte desse time é ter visão de dono, trabalhar em equipe e focado na busca por resultados ancorados em boas relações. Com Colaboradores e com o Cliente. Foi no Rio de Janeiro, no mais carioca dos shoppings, o Rio Sul, que nasceu a primeira loja AVIATOR. Com uma camisaria que impressionava por seu acabamento impecável, modelagem precisa e boa oferta de cores. Ao longo dos anos a marca se estabeleceu como inquestionável destino para quem buscava clássicos do guarda roupa masculino, com preço convidativo e reconhecida qualidade. De lá pra cá, ampliamos a variedade de itens, tendo como fio condutor a atemporalidade de um produto bem feito e livre de modismos. Hoje, temos da t-shirt ao blazer, do tênis ao tricot. Hoje, a AVIATOR está presente em todo o Rio de Janeiro: do Leme ao Pontal, passando pelo Centro, Zonas Sul, Norte e Barra da Tijuca, dando uma esticadinha em Niterói. Em julho de 2024, nossas asas pousaram em SP, com a abertura da 1ª loja no Pátio Paulista, e, em julho de 2025, abrimos a 2ª loja no Shopping Ibirapuera. Em 2011 inauguramos a loja on-line, disponibilizando a marca para consumidores em todo o país. "Um passo a frente você já não está mais no mesmo lugar." Se movimentar é preciso e, na evolução da marca, sabemos que ficar parado não é opção. Ao longo de nossa jornada, entendemos que nosso compromisso vai muito além de oferecer produtos e experiência de compra. Fazer parte ativamente da cena do empreendedorismo brasileiro nos mantém inquietos e fiéis a nossa essência. Não apenas vestimos, mas incentivamos empreendedores brasileiros de maneira ativa. Nosso projeto de incentivo ao empreendedorismo. Através delebuscamos alimentar o ecossistema do empreendedorismo brasileiro e mostrar as novas formas e experiências de trabalho e negócios. Seja contando histórias inspiradoras, seja viabilizando a aceleração de startups promissoras, é através dessa iniciativa que nos conectamos com as próximas empresas de sucesso. title: TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM - CER CENTRO
description: A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. title: TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM - CER CENTRO
description: Job description A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Inclusão A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades. description: Descrição O Mecânico de Manutenção de Equipamentos Pesados será um profissional chave na equipe, responsável por assegurar a plena operacionalidade e segurança de uma vasta gama de máquinas. title: Mecânico Diesel
description: Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução. O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada. No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR). No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo. Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia. Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável. A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento. A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG. Vem acelerar a sua carreira com o Grupo WLM! Confira as atribuições e vantagens da vaga de MECÂNICO DIESEL abaixo e venha fazer parte desse time de sucesso: Responsabilidades: Elabora desempeno de chassis, planos de manutenção; realiza manutenções de motores, sistemas e partes de veículos automotores. Substitui peças, repara e testa desempenho de componentes e sistemas de veículos. Efetua diagnóstico e reparo em conjuntos mecânicos, pneumáticos, hidráulicos e elétricos, socorre veículos, atuando como motorista até o local do socorro. Realiza serviços de lubrificação dos veículos utilizando bomba de lubrificação em eixos, quinta roda, sistema direcional, embuchamento e suspenção de acordo com a demanda especifica de cada veículo (preventiva e corretiva). Faz orçamento de mão de obra e peças a serem aplicadas. Realização habitual e intermitente de solda elétrica por eletrodos. Quando necessário, sendo habilitado e autorizado, dirige veículos de propriedade da empresa para atendimento externos aos clientes. Requisitos: Ensino Médio completo Informática Básica. Noção/experiência em mecânica de autos ou pesados. Desejável curso técnico em mecânica. Imprescindivel disponibilidade de viagens! O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Come deliver this transformation. About the Role Commure is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own the platform powering our fleet of OpenClaw agents. Across Commure, we use autonomous agents to support teams, execute operational workflows, interact with internal systems, and turn organizational knowledge into action. As the number and capabilities of these agents grow, we need a strong technical foundation for deploying, operating, observing, and improving them safely at scale. You’ll own that foundation. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering and applied AI. You’ll build the infrastructure that runs our agents, develop the harnesses that govern how they reason and act, and establish the tools engineers need to create and deploy new agents quickly. You’ll also operate the existing agent fleet and ensure it remains secure, reliable, observable, and cost-efficient. We’re looking for a strong Python engineer with deep Linux fundamentals who can own both the agent software and the environments where it runs. The ideal candidate combines platform-engineering rigor with practical experience building LLM-powered agents and is comfortable moving between Python application code, Bash-based operational work, Linux virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands‑on role for someone equally comfortable working inside a Linux VM, debugging a Kubernetes workload, writing Python services and automation, designing an agent tool interface, investigating an LLM failure, and improving a deployment pipeline. What You’ll Do Own the infrastructure and runtime environment for Commure’s fleet of OpenClaw agents. Build, configure, deploy, and troubleshoot agents running across Linux-based virtual machines. Develop Python services, automation, operational tooling, and agent integrations. Design, build, and operate agent harnesses that support tool use, memory, context management, permissions, scheduling, retries, and human escalation. Create a standardized platform for engineers to develop, test, deploy, and update agents safely. Deploy and operate agent workloads across Linux virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud or AWS. Use Bash and standard Linux tooling to investigate system behavior, automate environment management, and resolve production issues. Build reliable systems for agent scheduling, background execution, queues, concurrency management, and long‑running tasks. Develop integrations that allow agents to interact with internal services, databases, APIs, communication platforms, and operational tools. Establish secure approaches to secrets, credentials, identity, permissions, and access control for autonomous agents. Build evaluation frameworks that measure agent reliability, task completion, tool accuracy, latency, and cost. Implement production observability across agent traces, prompts, tool calls, infrastructure, failures, and resource consumption. Create dashboards, alerting, and incident‑response processes for agent and platform health. Diagnose failures across application code, model behavior, third‑party tools, networks, containers, virtual machines, and cloud infrastructure. Improve the efficiency and resilience of the platform as agent usage and workload complexity grow. Work closely with product engineers and internal teams to convert promising agent prototypes into dependable production systems. Establish best practices for developing and operating autonomous agents across Commure. What You Have Professional experience building and operating production software, infrastructure, or internal platforms. Strong proficiency in Python, which will be the primary language for agent development, platform tooling, integrations, and automation. Excellent familiarity with Linux environments and hands‑on experience developing, deploying, and debugging software on virtual machines. Strong Bash and command‑line skills, including shell scripting, process management, networking diagnostics, filesystem operations, package management, and log investigation. Experience managing software across fleets of virtual machines, including configuration, deployment, monitoring, access management, and failure recovery. Strong hands‑on experience building and operating production systems on Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services, including compute, networking, storage, identity and access management, and observability. Experience deploying and managing Linux virtual machines and containerised workloads in cloud environments. Hands‑on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and containerised production workloads. Experience building infrastructure, deployment systems, internal developer platforms, or distributed application runtimes. Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration management, secrets management, and automated deployments. Hands‑on experience building with large language models, autonomous agents, or agent harnesses. An understanding of agent concepts such as tool calling, memory, context management, planning, retries, evaluations, permissions, and human‑in‑the‑loop execution. Experience monitoring and debugging distributed systems using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts. A strong understanding of production reliability, including failure recovery, idempotency, rate limiting, concurrency management, and incident response. The ability to balance fast experimentation with the security and reliability required for production systems. Strong ownership and communication skills, including comfort working across product, infrastructure, security, and operational teams. A builder mindset and excitement about creating infrastructure for a rapidly evolving category of software. Nice to Have You have built, extended, deployed, or operated an OpenClaw agent. You have contributed to OpenClaw or another open‑source agent framework. Experience operating a fleet of autonomous or long‑running AI agents. Experience building multi‑tenant agent platforms or internal developer platforms. Experience with agent evaluation, tracing, replay, simulation, or regression testing. Experience with browser agents, computer‑use agents, or agents that interact with external systems. Familiarity with model gateways, inference providers, prompt versioning, token accounting, and LLM cost optimisation. Experience securing workloads that access sensitive data or high‑impact production tools. Familiarity with Swift and experience contributing to or supporting native Apple client applications. Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle management, or another regulated industry. What Success Looks Like Within your first several months, you will: Develop a deep understanding of our existing OpenClaw agents, infrastructure, and operational workflows. Make the agent fleet easier to deploy, observe, debug, and maintain. Establish clear reliability and performance metrics for agents running in production. Reduce the time required to take an agent from prototype to production. Improve safeguards around credentials, permissions, tool execution, and sensitive data. Improve the reliability, repeatability, and security of our Linux VM and Kubernetes‑based agent environments. Create a platform that allows Commure teams to build increasingly capable agents without reinventing the underlying infrastructure. title: Senior Software Engineer, RCM Email Agents
description: At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.” Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here. The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation. About The Role Commure is hiring a Senior Software Engineer in Rio de Janeiro to help build and scale our RCM Email Agents. Healthcare revenue cycle teams manage an enormous volume of operational email—from claim and payment questions to enrollment, reconciliation, and customer support workflows. Our agents understand these messages, gather the necessary context, take action across internal systems, and resolve work that would otherwise require significant manual effort. You’ll own these systems end to end: the agent harness and tools, backend APIs, data models, operator-facing interfaces, evaluations, and production infrastructure. You’ll work closely with engineers and RCM operators to turn complex workflows into reliable agents that can operate safely at scale. This is a hands‑on role for an experienced product engineer who enjoys moving quickly, working across the stack, and owning production outcomes—not just writing isolated services. What You’ll Do Design, build, and operate production AI agents that handle high-volume RCM email workflows. Develop agent harnesses that support tool use, structured workflows, context management, human escalation, and reliable execution. Build scalable backend services and APIs using Python and FastAPI. Create intuitive React and JavaScript interfaces for operations teams to review, manage, and improve agent activity. Design PostgreSQL schemas and data pipelines that support workflow state, auditability, analytics, and agent performance. Integrate agents with email systems, internal Commure services, healthcare workflows, and third‑party platforms. Build evaluation frameworks to measure agent accuracy, resolution rate, escalation rate, latency, and cost. Establish monitoring, alerting, reporting, and safeguards for business‑critical agent workflows. Investigate production failures, identify root causes, and improve the reliability of the overall system. Work directly with RCM operators and customers to understand workflows and rapidly turn their feedback into product improvements. Own projects from initial problem definition through implementation, deployment, and measurable production impact. Help establish a strong engineering culture as we grow our team in Rio. What You Have Professional experience building and operating production software systems. Strong proficiency in Python, including experience developing APIs and services with FastAPI. Strong full‑stack development skills, with experience building modern applications using React and JavaScript or TypeScript. Experience designing data models and production systems with PostgreSQL. Hands‑on experience building with LLMs, AI agents, or agent harnesses, including concepts such as tool calling, orchestration, context management, evaluations, retries, and human‑in‑the‑loop workflows. A strong understanding of production engineering, including testing, observability, alerting, incident response, and system reliability. Experience with containers and cloud infrastructure, such as Docker and Kubernetes. The ability to move quickly while maintaining a high bar for correctness, maintainability, and user experience. Strong product judgment and an instinct for simplifying complex operational workflows. Excellent ownership and communication skills, including the ability to work directly with technical and non‑technical stakeholders. A builder mindset and excitement about applying AI to high‑impact healthcare problems. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. Nice to Have Experience building email agents, support automation, workflow engines, or other asynchronous processing systems. Experience developing evaluation systems for LLM‑powered products. Familiarity with revenue cycle management, healthcare billing, claims, remittance, or practice‑management workflows. Experience building systems that require strong auditability, security, and data privacy. Experience operating high‑volume distributed systems with queues, background workers, and third‑party integrations. title: Especialista de Food Hall
description: ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. title: Head of Marketing & Growth - Playbook
description: Job Description About Better Collective Better Collective is a global digital sports media group on a mission to excite sports fans and build communities worldwide. We operate at the intersection of sports, media, technology, betting, and prediction markets. With brands like FUTBIN, HLTV, Action Network, Playmaker HQ, VegasInsider, Bolavip, FutbolSites, and more, we engage 450+ million monthly users worldwide. We combine the scale of a corporation with the speed and mindset of a startup. About The Role We’re looking for a Head of Marketing & Growth to join Better Collective and help us own the full marketing function for Playbook and be the primary driver of new user acquisition and retention. You will collaborate with the GM of Playbook, product, analytics, design, and engineers and contribute to setting strategy, campaign execution, spend optimization, testing, and go-to-market for new feature launches. What you’ll be doing Own end-to-end go-to-market planning and execution for new product surfaces as they roll out. Lead GTM sequencing and prioritization across channels for major moments, including sporting calendar events, product launches, and market entries. Partner with product on feature positioning and messaging to translate the roadmap into a clear, phased market rollout plan. Build repeatable GTM playbooks so future launches can move faster. Own the growth P&L across paid (X/Meta and emerging channels), organic social, and email/CRM. Build and manage budget allocation models to maximize new user growth and retention within CAC targets. Define and own the core growth funnel and identify the highest-leverage points for intervention. Plan and execute always-on and moment-driven campaigns across owned and paid channels. Build and run follower growth, referral, and reactivation campaigns using mechanics like streaks, deeplinks, and gamified incentives. Obsess over retention metrics and build lifecycle programs to improve them. Partner with analytics to build cohort-level views of user behavior and translate insights into marketing action. What we’re looking for 6-8+ years of marketing/growth experience. Experience in the sports betting, gaming, or affiliate/media industry. Proven track record owning paid and organic acquisition channels with real budget and CAC/LTV accountability. Experience building and scaling retention/lifecycle programs. Hands-on experience launching go-to-market plans for new products or features. Strong command of performance marketing fundamentals alongside brand/content instincts. Nice To Have Experience with, or strong familiarity with, growth mechanics like referrals, streaks, deeplinks, and social-native distribution. Comfortable operating across multiple markets and regulatory environments (US, UK, Brazil). Experience working in a startup environment. Social media experience. What we offer The opportunity to work with talented colleagues across multiple countries and cultures A high level of ownership and trust in your work Flexibility in how and where you work (depending on location and team setup) Learning and development opportunities as you grow your career The chance to work with products and brands used by millions of sports fans worldwide #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Premium Watch Sales Specialist
description: Sell premium and luxury watches at sea, earn up to 6% commission on watch sales, and build relationships with guests from around the world. We’re looking for experienced Watch Sales Specialists to join our onboard retail teams, working on cruise ships around the world. This is a unique opportunity for someone with proven experience selling luxury watches. You’ll need strong product knowledge, confidence with premium and Swiss watch brands, and the ability to guide guests through a considered, high-value purchase with expertise and care. Working at sea is very different from working on the high street. You’ll live and work onboard, become part of a close-knit team, and have the opportunity to develop guest relationships across the cruise. Some guests may buy in the moment. Others may return several times before making a decision. Your role is to guide that journey with patience, knowledge and strong commercial instinct. This is a chance to combine luxury watch sales, travel and excellent earning potential, with the opportunity to earn up to 6% commission on premium watch sales, on top of salary. About Harding+ Harding+ is a leading cruise retail business, working closely with cruise line partners and brand partners to make every cruise better. Our onboard boutiques offer guests a carefully selected range of products across categories including watches, fine jewellery, fashion, beauty, liquor, confectionery and logo products. We are proud to have been recognised as Cruise Retailer of the Year in 2022, 2023 and 2025, reflecting our focus on outstanding service, strong brand partnerships and memorable guest experiences. What You’ll Do As a Watch Sales Specialist , you’ll be responsible for delivering a premium guest experience and maximising watch sales onboard. You’ll welcome guests into the boutique, understand what they are looking for, and use your product knowledge to recommend pieces that feel relevant to their style, occasion or collection. You’ll confidently introduce guests to different watch brands, explain features and value, invite them to handle and try pieces, and help them imagine ownership. You’ll know when to give space, when to continue the conversation, and when to move naturally towards commitment. You’ll also support onboard events, presentations and promotions, using these moments to create interest, generate leads and bring guests back into the boutique. Alongside this, you’ll maintain excellent product presentation, support stock and compliance processes, and share your knowledge with the wider team. This role is about more than product knowledge. It requires presence, composure and the ability to build trust with guests who may be considering a significant purchase. What You’ll Bring Proven experience selling luxury watches Strong knowledge of premium and Swiss watch brands Experience guiding customers through high-value or considered purchases Motivation and ambition to achieve and exceed sales targets Confidence delivering product presentations, seminars or guest events A flexible, team-focused attitude and the ability to adapt to life at sea Fluency in English; additional languages would be an advantage A good level of physical fitness, as the role involves being active throughout the day What You’ll Get Competitive salary, plus up to 6% commission – all take home pay Included accommodation and meals provided onboard No household bills while you are working at sea Support with necessary visas and seafaring documents Dedicated in-house training across sales, product and brand knowledge The opportunity to travel the world while earning Contracts of up to 6 months onboard, usually followed by 1 to 2 months at home between contracts On selected cruise lines, the opportunity to travel independently after your contract, with support for your return travel home afterwards Bring your expertise, your confidence and your passion for watches, and start your next adventure with Harding+. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Growth Strategy Manager (Brazil Market)- Based in Buenos Aires
description: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands‑on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. Meet the Team Growth is the team managing the engine responsible for driving the Fever growth ambition across all markets. Our goal is to ensure our partners thrive by leveraging Fever’s world‑leading data, marketing and product technology. We aim to fully understand the Fever business and work collaboratively with other teams to achieve the growth ambitions of Fever and our partners. The Role As a Growth Strategy Manager, you will be a key architect of Fever’s expansion across the Brazil region. You won’t just execute projects; you will own the growth roadmap, defining how we build our business model and partner portfolio. Working at the intersection of data, marketing and business development, you will lead key projects and partners that drive our success in Brazil. What You’ll Do You will be responsible for: Market Growth and Leadership: Define and lead the business plan for key Brazil expansion areas and partners. While driving projects with key impact on product prioritization and localized revenue optimization. Strategic leadership: Act as a lead advisor to our top-tier strategic partners. Leverage Fever’s proprietary data and technology to help our partners succeed and grow. Strategic Impact: Move beyond analysis to implementation. Lead projects that turn complex data into actionable business cases, and take full accountability for moving key business metrics (CAC, LTV, ROI). Operational Excellence: Optimize new business streams and cross-functional workflows. You will ensure that as we scale, our operations remain lean, efficient and capable of supporting rapid growth across diverse markets. Global Stakeholder Management: Work closely with key regional stakeholders (i.e. Country and Regional General Managers) across our key Brazilian market to help them build business cases for local marketing and technology needs within Fevers global product and marketing capabilities. Who You Are Experience: At least 4-5 years of experience in an analytical business role with experience in strategy consulting, fast growing startups, or investment banking, a plus, including a proven track record of leading complex projects and delivering measurable business growth. Background: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Maths, Statistics, Data Analytics or Strategy. Analytical skills: Ability to leverage data, make strategic business decisions and craft convincing narratives for senior stakeholders. Communication skills: Excellent interpersonal skills and a demonstrated ability to manage, influence and align diverse stakeholders across different cultures and disciplines. Mindset: Proactive problem-solver who can handle ambiguity and make high‑stakes decisions. Passionate about industry trends and eager to explore new growth opportunities in a fast‑paced evolving environment. Languages: Fluency in English and Portuguese is a must. Spanish is a plus. Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Python or R is preferred. Willing to relocate to Buenos Aires, Argentina. Why You’ll Love it Here Attractive compensation package, including stock options to reward your contributions and growth. 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences + free Candlelight voucher. 20 days of paid annual leave to support your well‑being and personal time outside of work. Private health & dental insurance: OSDE 410 plan fully covered by Fever. Wellhub membership for gym and wellness access: 100% covered by Fever up to the Silver plan. Language learning support: English and Spanish lessons. Hybrid work setup: home office friendly with a central Buenos Aires office location. Dynamic international team: a young, talented group creating a great work environment. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone’s background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey. If you want to know more about how Fever processes your personal data, click here Fever - Candidate Privacy Notice #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Coordenador de Desenvolvimento humano e organizacional / DHO

Liderar e desenvolver a equipe, garantir a governança dos ciclos de pessoas e atuar de forma consultiva junto às lideranças, áreas e operações, promovendo cultura, clima, engajamento, desempenho, desenvolvimento e uma jornada positiva do colaborador, em alinhamento com as necessidades do negócio. Desdobrar as estratégias e diretrizes da Gerência de DHO em planos de trabalho, cronogramas, metas, responsabilidades e rotinas de acompanhamento. Coordenar os ciclos de gestão de desempenho, garantindo comunicação, parametrização de sistemas, orientações, controles, consolidação de resultados, qualidade das avaliações e cumprimento dos prazos. Garantir a elaboração e o acompanhamento dos Planos de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), orientando gestores e monitorando evolução, evidências e efetividade das ações. Coordenar o diagnóstico de necessidades de treinamento e desenvolvimento, a construção do plano anual de capacitação e a implantação de trilhas por cargo, competência e público. Supervisionar treinamentos, workshops, integrações e ações de desenvolvimento, assegurando qualidade de conteúdo, logística, fornecedores, registros, avaliação e aplicação do aprendizado. Conduzir ou supervisionar entrevistas, grupos focais, escutas estruturadas e análises de dados para identificar fatores de engajamento, riscos de clima e oportunidades de melhoria. Coordenar programas de desenvolvimento de liderança, formação de talentos, mapeamento de posições críticas, sucessão e mobilidade interna. Participar da construção e atualização de modelos de competências, descrições de cargos, trilhas de carreira e critérios de desenvolvimento e promoção. Organizar e participar dos comitês de pessoas, desempenho, carreira e sucessão, garantindo qualidade das informações, registros das decisões, encaminhamentos e prazos. Coordenar ações de cultura organizacional, valores, propósito, reconhecimento, diversidade, inclusão, pertencimento e experiência do colaborador. Planejar, em conjunto com Comunicação e demais áreas, iniciativas de comunicação interna e employer branding relacionadas aos programas de pessoas. Garantir a gestão da jornada do colaborador, do onboarding ao desenvolvimento, engajamento, reconhecimento, movimentações internas e desligamento responsável. Atuar como parceiro consultivo das lideranças, antecipando demandas, apoiando decisões de pessoas e integrando esforços com os demais subsistemas de RH. Coordenar o apoio às operações, unidades e implantações de contratos em ações de cultura, clima, integração, desenvolvimento, desempenho, retenção e gestão da mudança. Monitorar indicadores de DHO e pessoas, como turnover, absenteísmo, clima, desempenho, capacitação, mobilidade e satisfação interna, elaborando análises e recomendações para a gestão. Garantir a atualização e a confiabilidade de bases, dashboards, apresentações, relatórios gerenciais, evidências, documentos e sistemas da área. Gerir consultorias, plataformas e fornecedores de DHO, acompanhando escopo, contratos, qualidade, prazos, entregas e orçamento. Coordenar melhorias nos processos de DHO, promovendo padronização, automação, simplificação, eficiência e melhor experiência dos usuários internos. Coordenar iniciativas de transformação cultural e gestão da mudança, estruturando diagnósticos, planos de comunicação, engajamento das partes interessadas e acompanhamento da adesão. Apoiar a Gerência de DHO na construção do planejamento, do orçamento e das prioridades anuais da área, fornecendo dados, cenários e propostas. Atuar na mediação de conflitos e no apoio a situações críticas de pessoas, em conjunto com a Gerência de DHO e áreas responsáveis. Cumprir políticas internas, requisitos legais e diretrizes de proteção de dados aplicáveis aos processos e informações de pessoas. title: Network Implementation Expert
description: Who are we? Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. Joining our operations team means being at the center of everything - maintaining and evolving critical infrastructure that powers the digital world and delivers real impact for our customers, communities and society. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you- because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work. Job Summary The Network Implementation Expert joins the Managed Services organization to design, implement, and optimize advanced network infrastructures for enterprise and data center customers. This role serves as a technical authority for complex network deployments in hybrid environments, ensuring secure, scalable, and highly available solutions. The position contributes directly to operational excellence, automation initiatives, and the successful delivery of mission-critical customer projects. Key Responsibilities Design and lead the implementation of enterprise-grade network solutions in data center and hybrid environments. Act as a subject matter expert (SME) for complex network architectures, configurations, and integrations. Provide technical leadership during critical implementation phases, migrations, and transformations. Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, best practices, and governance frameworks. Drive automation and optimization initiatives to improve network reliability, performance, and operational efficiency. Collaborate with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver tailored, high-quality network solutions. Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend improvements to existing network environments. Support incident resolution and complex troubleshooting activities when required. Required Qualifications Technical Experience and Expertise Solid experience in network engineering within enterprise and/or data center environments. Proven ability to design, implement, and support highly available, secure, and resilient network infrastructures. Core Technical Skills Routing and Switching Advanced proficiency with enterprise-grade switches and routers (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, Arista). Demonstrated expertise with routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, and related technologies. Data Center Networking Hands-on experience with software-defined networking and fabric-based architectures (e.g., Cisco ACI, VMware NSX). Practical experience integrating multi-vendor network environments. Security and Firewalls Advanced knowledge of firewall platforms such as Fortinet, Palo Alto, and Cisco ASA. Practical experience with VPN technologies, including site-to-site and client-to-site connectivity. Familiarity with IDS/IPS solutions and network security best practices. High Availability and Resilience Demonstrated proficiency with redundancy and failover protocols such as HSRP, VRRP, and GLBP. Network Performance and Monitoring Strong understanding of Quality of Service (QoS) and traffic prioritization. Hands-on experience with monitoring and performance tools such as SolarWinds, Zabbix, or Nagios. Cloud and Hybrid Networking Solid knowledge of hybrid cloud networking across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Practical experience with cloud-native networking services, including load balancers, virtual gateways, and cloud security configurations. Language Skills Fluent English for technical communication, documentation, and presentations. Intermediate Spanish for collaboration with regional and global teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with network automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Ansible, Python, and Terraform. Industry-recognized certifications such as CCIE, JNCIE, or equivalent. Familiarity with MPLS and SD-WAN solutions. Additional professional certifications related to networking, cloud, or cybersecurity. Education Bachelor's degree in computer science, Telecommunications, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Specialized certifications and advanced academic qualifications are considered an advantage. Locations Equinix SP3 Av. Marcos Penteado de Ulhôa Rodrigues, 249 Santana de Parnaíba - SP CEP: Equinix RJ1 Rua Voluntários da Pátria, 360 Botafogo, Rio de Janeiro, RJ CEP , Brazil. Work Model Employees are expected to work 2 days per week from the office and 3 days remotely. Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. title: Digital Product Manager
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department Commercial & Marketing Location Brazil THE POSITION FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Vision: Play a leading role indefining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first-party data strategies. Value Generation : Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament-time digital operations, delivering high-traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross-functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Providing clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross-functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer-first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI-driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data-driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. YOUR PROFILE Education & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline Relevant product development philosophies, e.g. Agile, are essential Relevant project management qualifications, e.g. PRINCE2, highly beneficial Work Experience Product management experience, demonstrating end-to-end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct-to-consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills - both written and verbal – to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short-term opportunities. Competencies Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complimented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data-driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology Strong knowledge of digital direct-to-consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI Experience with industry-standard solutions, e.g. Figma, Asana and Confluence Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Working closely with the Stadium Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximise efficiencies across the wider project. Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all non-competition venues. Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing and signage operations and reporting updates into the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimised at all stages of the project. Liaising with non-competition owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. Attending department-specific and organisation site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. Inputting into the site-specific dressing and wayfinding signage strategies utilising expertise from previous events and directives from management. YOUR PROFILE Strong experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 4 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.) Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects. Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições. Fique tranquilo (a) ao cadastrar seus dados na vaga. O Grupo Salta segue a LGPD – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (Lei Federal 13.709/2018), que entrou em vigor em agosto de 2020, logo, garantimos responsabilidade ao utilizar seus dados somente em nosso processo seletivo, para fins de cadastro e controle de candidatos. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Supervisor(a) de Produção
description: A Michelin, líder do segmento de pneus, se dedica ao desenvolvimento da mobilidade de seus clientes, de forma sustentável, criando e distribuindo os pneus, serviços e soluções mais adequados às suas necessidades, fornecendo serviços digitais, mapas e guias, para ajuda-los a tornar suas viagens experiências únicas; e desenvolvendo materiais de alta tecnologia , que atendem à indústria da mobilidade. Defendemos nossos valores de respeito aos clientes, às pessoas, aos acionistas, ao meio ambiente e aos fatos em todos os lugares onde estamos presentes. Nós nos importamos em dar as pessoas uma melhor maneira de seguir em frente. Seja parte de um time no qual você é empoderado e encorajado a alcançar o seu potencial ao máximo e a realizar as suas ambições. Ao redor do mundo, através da diversidade, ajude a criar o futuro da Michelin com paixão, entusiasmo e orgulho. Com a mesma atenção aos nossos colaboradores e clientes, nós inovamos além e melhor pela sustentabilidade. Valorizamos as singularidades de cada um e consideramos a diversidade como um valor, por isso reforçamos este convite para você, que se autodeclara negro ou negra , do gênero feminino ou masculino , LGBTQIA+ , pessoa com deficiência ou acima de 50 anos. Conheça mais sobre o site que você irá trabalhar: O Complexo industrial de Campo Grande/RJ é responsável pela produção de pneus para ônibus, caminhões, mineração e máquinas agrícolas; que abastecem o mercado mundial. Missão: Liderar as operações produtivas, promovendo excelência em Segurança, Qualidade, Entrega, Custo e Pessoas, por meio do desenvolvimento das equipes, da melhoria contínua e da aplicação dos princípios de Lean Manufacturing. Será responsável por conectar a estratégia da empresa à execução no chão de fábrica, impulsionando uma cultura de alta performance, inovação e transformação industrial. Principais atividades: Liderar as operações produtivas, garantindo o alcance das metas. Promover a melhoria contínua por meio das ferramentas de Lean Manufacturing. Assegurar o cumprimento dos padrões operacionais, segurança e qualidade dos processos. Analisar e solucionar problemas, implementando ações corretivas e preventivas. Conduzir a transformação digital e apoiar projetos de automação e industrialização. Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Manutenção, Qualidade, Logística, RH e Excelência Operacional para garantir os resultados da operação. Gerenciar indicadores, promover a gestão da mudança e disseminar a cultura de segurança e melhoria contínua. Graduação completa em Engenharia de Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica, Automação e Controle, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas e Administração. Sólida experiência em gestão de operações industriais e liderança de equipes. Vivência em ambientes de manufatura de alta performance. Conhecimento e aplicação de Lean Manufacturing e melhoria contínua. Experiência com gestão de indicadores operacionais e desenvolvimento de pessoas. Vivência em gestão de mudanças e projetos de transformação industrial será considerada um diferencial. Local de trabalho/base: Campo Grande - RJ #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo. Create a standardized platform for engineers to develop, test, deploy, and update agents safely. Deploy and operate agent workloads across Linux virtual machines, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud or AWS. Use Bash and standard Linux tooling to investigate system behavior, automate environment management, and resolve production issues. Create dashboards, alerting, and incident-response processes for agent and platform health. Diagnose failures across application code, model behavior, third-party tools, networks, containers, virtual machines, and cloud infrastructure. Improve the efficiency and resilience of the platform as agent usage and workload complexity grow. Establish best practices for developing and operating autonomous agents across Commure. Excellent familiarity with Linux environments and hands‑on experience developing, deploying, and debugging software on virtual machines. Strong Bash and command‑line skills, including shell scripting, process management, networking diagnostics, filesystem operations, package management, and log investigation. Experience managing software across fleets of virtual machines, including configuration, deployment, monitoring, access management, and failure recovery. Strong hands‑on experience building and operating production systems on Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services, including compute, networking, storage, identity and access management, and observability. Experience building infrastructure, deployment systems, internal developer platforms, or distributed application runtimes. Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure as code, configuration management, secrets management, and automated deployments. Hands‑on experience building with large language models, autonomous agents, or agent harnesses. Experience monitoring and debugging distributed systems using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts. A strong understanding of production reliability, including failure recovery, idempotency, rate limiting, concurrency management, and incident response. The ability to balance fast experimentation with the security and reliability required for production systems. Strong ownership and communication skills, including comfort working across product, infrastructure, security, and operational teams. A builder mindset and excitement about creating infrastructure for a rapidly evolving category of software. Nice to Have You have built, extended, deployed, or operated an OpenClaw agent. You have contributed to OpenClaw or another open-source agent framework. Experience operating a fleet of autonomous or long‑running AI agents. Experience building multi‑tenant agent platforms or internal developer platforms. Experience with agent evaluation, tracing, replay, simulation, or regression testing. Experience with browser agents, computer‑use agents, or agents that interact with external systems. Familiarity with model gateways, inference providers, prompt versioning, token accounting, and LLM cost optimization. Experience securing workloads that access sensitive data or high‑impact production tools. Familiarity with Swift and experience contributing to or supporting native Apple client applications. Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle management, or another regulated industry. Improve the reliability, repeatability, and security of our Linux VM and Kubernetes‑based agent environments. A posição exige forte capacidade de exploração e facilitação de dinâmicas de alinhamento e descoberta, transformando jornadas complexas em soluções tangíveis — incluindo o design de dashboards e visualizações de dados. title: Vehicle Access and Parking Permit (VAPP) Manager
description: Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The Vehicle Access and Parking Permit (VAPP) Programme Manager shall be responsible for the planning, development, implementation and overall management of the VAPP Programme for the FWWC2027 Tournament, ensuring that all vehicle accreditation and parking operations are delivered in accordance with FIFA27 operational requirements. The role shall coordinate the design, production, allocation, distribution and control of VAPPs, ensuring effective integration with all FIFA27 Functional Areas, Host Cities, stadiums, airports, training sites and other relevant stakeholders. The VAPP Programme Manager shall also oversee the planning, allocation and distribution of workforce public transport cards, ensuring compliance with established eligibility criteria, operational timelines and service levels, while maintaining accurate records, reporting and effective stakeholder coordination throughout the Tournament lifecycle. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Act as the primary liaison between the Transport FA and FIFA27 departments for all VAPP related planning and operational matters for FWWC2027 and any ancillary event. Actively lead and contribute on the development and implementation of the Host Cities Vehicles Access and/or Parking Permits (VAPPs) and venue/stadium transport access operational plans. Deliver FWWC2027 VAPP scheme taking into consideration all factors surrounding the guests and Workforce’ journey. Lead the procurement, contract implementation and performance management of the service provider(s) responsible for the production, printing, packaging and distribution of all VAPPs, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, production schedules, quality standards, security protocols, inventory control, distribution plans and agreed service levels throughout the Tournament lifecycle. Manage VAPP system and the supporting tools and systems (in coordination with FIFA27 Client Services) and ensure integration with other systems/ platforms within Operations department and other FIFA27 departments. Engage with all stakeholders effectively; collect requirements, update and maintain VAPPs database, and assist with the distribution of VAPPs to all guest groups in coordination with guest group owners (departments/ functional areas). Create and maintain comprehensive processes to obtain necessary documents from all functional areas/ departments to facilitate the permit application. Work closely with key partners and service providers to monitor and ensure VAPPs activities are being executed in alignment with the contractual requirements. Develop FWWC2027 VAPP Guide(s), policies and related procedures. Work closely with the relevant local authorities and FWWC2027 Security Department in the implementation of the Vehicle Permit Checkpoints (e.g. at vehicle screening areas). Prepare and submit forms/ applications and letters to various departments/ functional areas having jurisdiction over required permits and/or approvals. Manage the onsite VAPP helpdesk for all incoming enquiries during operational period The specific duties of this role may evolve and change through the operational planning and delivery phases. YOUR PROFILE Qualifications: Education – bachelor’s degree in Transport/Logistics/ Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset. Experience: Experience managing service providers, including procurement support, contract administration, supplier performance management and service level monitoring. Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and engaging with public authorities, venue operators, suppliers and internal stakeholders. Experience managing operational databases, permit or accreditation systems, or other information management platforms is highly desirable. Experience developing operational procedures, policies, user guides and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Experience working in an international, multicultural and fast-paced environment is desirable. Previous experience in large events would be an advantage, but is not mandatory. Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data validation, pivot tables, advanced formulas, and large database management. Strong ability to work with operational systems, online platforms, databases and reporting tools. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify inconsistencies, gaps, duplications and risks in data and operational records. Ability to produce clear reports, trackers, dashboards and status updates for management and stakeholders. Strong attention to detail, especially when dealing with permits, vehicle data, stakeholder requests and controlled documents. Ability to translate operational requirements into system requirements, user guides and practical procedures. Ability to work under pressure to immoveable deadlines. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Job description A Globoé feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro. Gente espalhada por todo o país (e mundo!) trabalhando com conteúdo, notícias, negócios, tecnologia e brasilidade de sobra. Canais na TV aberta e por assinatura, produtos digitais como globoplay, Cartola, g1, ge, gshow e outros serviços estão reunidos no mesmo lugar, na mesma Globo. Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões. Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. O Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC) da Globo tem a missão de viabilizar e agregar valor às operações da empresa. Com uma grande diversidade de escopos e de colaboradores (são mais de 1.700), é natural que tenha um desafio de governança. Com um robusto orçamento de investimentos e despesas para prestar serviços internos e desenvolver projetos de conservação e modernização do parque de infraestrutura, a diretoria sensibiliza os direcionadores estratégicos da Globo de geração de valor econômico-financeiro e de compromissos ESG. Neste contexto, torna-se essencial um modelo de gestão robusto, com métricas, rotinas, padrões, reportes e captação do valor gerado pela aplicação de tantos recursos e processos. O VMO beneficia o CSC construindo uma visão estratégica da diretoria e garantindo uma governança de projetos madura, com metodologia, entregas transparentes, de qualidade e alinhadas com a Globo. Main responsibilities Como será seu dia a dia: Como atendimento em projetos: Acompanha e reporta o desenvolvimento dos projetos de áreas clientes, verificando o cumprimento de cronogramas, orçamento, escopo e critérios de qualidade/valor; Elabora, define e dissemina metodologias e ferramentas que apoiem o gerenciamento de projetos nas áreas e projetos estratégicos da diretoria, sempre alinhado com as últimas tendências; Apoia a interface com outras áreas envolvidas nos projetos; Analisa os indicadores de projetos, reportando os resultados na área; Atua como gestor de projetos adHOC, estruturando um plano, antecipando riscos, formatando, acompanhando e reportando o desenvolvimento dos trabalhos e gerindo os impactos de forma a preservar os produtos combinados. No ciclo orçamentário de projetos: Levanta e elabora cenários para defesa do ciclo com contexto interno, externo e desafios; Conduz e consolida defesa dos projetos dos departamentos para o diretor executivo; Presta consultoria e suporte técnico às áreas no período de ciclo orçamentário, utilizando como base as melhores práticas e uso de ferramentas; Consolida o orçamento de projetos dos departamentos e elabora apresentação para defesa do planejamento do CSC para os próximos anos. Na gestão de OKRs: Conduz e reporta o andamento dos OKRs estratégicos do CSC e táticos de Governança e Controle; Conduz o processo de definição, acompanhamento e revisão de OKRs, alinhados à estratégia da organização; Facilita workshops e reuniões de alinhamento com lideranças e pontos focais. No apoio à medição e melhoria de processos e tarefas: Analisa gaps, tendências e desvios, propondo e/ou cobrando planos de ação para correções de rumo; Analisa, consolida, valida e divulga, periodicamente, indicadores e resultados por meio relatórios gerenciais; Identifica oportunidades de otimização operacional nas áreas, a fim de eliminar desperdícios. No apoio à gestão: Elabora conteúdos gerenciais, com visão executiva que facilitem a análise de informações para acompanhamento de resultados e tomada de decisão; Realiza ações de comunicação e engajamento, acerca de assuntos que são transversais na área, a fim de garantir abrangência, uniformidade e alinhamento. Requirements and skills Do que você precisa: Superior completo; Habilidade no pacote Microsoft 365, com destaque ao Excel e Power Point (intermediário/avançado). Produção de relatórios em Power BI (intermediário); Conhecimento e experiência em gestão de projetos (métodos tradicionais ou ágeis) e OKR; Visão analítica; Organização e energia para lidar com múltiplas iniciativas ao mesmo tempo. Conhecimentos que te destacam: Gestão e melhoria contínua de processos (PDCA, DMAIC, ferramenta Bizagi, etc); Automação de processos. Ex: Agentes de IA, VBA no Excel, Power Automate no Microsoft 365, etc; Certificações como PMP, Scrum Master, Lean Six Sigma ou similares; Vivência em ambientes corporativos com estrutura de VMO ou PMO; Usuário de ferramenta de controle de projetos (PPM). Ex: ERP Oracle, Jira, Clarity PPM, Primavera, etc; Uso de inteligência artificial aplicada à gestão de projetos ou processos (ex: agentes com o Copilot Studio). Additional information Por que vir para Globo: Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer. Establish and manage relationships with the hotel industry to provide the best overall value to FIFA and PMA’s Ensure records of accommodation bookings, rooming lists, and related information comply with data integrity and protection regulations. Manage reconciliation, billing and closeout for assigned teams Support in the implementation of contingency plans to address unforeseen changes, cancellations, or emergencies in accommodation arrangements. Provide support as necessary for various ancillary projects taking place in the leadup to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Stay updated with industry trends, regulations, best practices and innovations in the accommodation environment, applying relevant knowledge to enhance the overall accommodation operation for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Right to work in Brazil. title: Sr Software Engineer, Frontend (Web)
description: About the Role Please note: this hybrid position is based in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro, Brazil – welcoming both local professionals and those open to relocating. As part of our engineering team, you’ll work on large-scale applications that impact millions of users.You’ll collaborate with cross-functional partners (design, backend, data science, product). About the Teams Delivery: The Delivery team is focused on innovating and streamlining how products and services reach our customers. In this role, you'll contribute to building efficient and robust systems that support order processing, logistics, and real-time tracking. Your contributions will help optimize the end-to-end delivery experience, making it more reliable and seamless for both drivers and customers. ADS: The Ads team builds and scales the advertising platform and its features that power sponsored experiences across Uber’s apps, connecting riders, eaters, and advertisers in relevant and measurable ways. The team owns end-to-end ad delivery (from ad creation, rendering, and experimentation to tracking, measurement, and performance optimization) across mobile and web surfaces. The work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and data, ensuring ads are high-quality for users while driving impact for advertisers and Uber’s business. Mobility (Rider Core): Millions of people depend on Uber’s web application to make ride reservations and get on-demand Uber rides. The Rider Core Team at Uber is redefining what it means to Uber and expanding our products beyond on-demand rides. In this role, you'll work with many distributed teams, ranging from designers, engineers, and data scientists, to provide market-defining products and trip planning experiences over the web. What You’ll Do Design and implement user-facing features for critical web properties at scale, making engineering trade-offs between speed, maintainability, and user experience. Own the technical design and execution of features, from initial architecture discussions to debugging production issues. Collaborate across disciplines, Product, Design, Data Science, and Backend Engineering, to turn ambiguous business needs into clear, scalable front-end systems. Champion front-end engineering excellence, defining and leading the adoption of code health, testing, and design standards within your project area. Improve core application performance, efficiency, and system reliability, proactively identifying and tackling areas of technical debt in software and processes within your team. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on best practices, system design philosophy, and navigating cross‑functional project dynamics. What You’ll Need 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a focus on large-scale, high-traffic web applications. Hands‑on experience and proficiency in a modern web framework such as JavaScript, React, VueJS, or Angular, plus HTML and CSS. Proficiency in fundamental algorithms and data structures, including hash tables, trees, stacks, queues, linked lists, DFS, and BFS. Demonstrated understanding of modern web application architecture and design patterns, and their implications for performance and scalability. Advanced English communication skills, written and verbal, to effectively collaborate with globally distributed cross‑functional teams. Bonus Points If Experience leading the technical direction of complex, cross‑functional projects with multiple dependencies. Familiarity with back‑end systems (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript) to facilitate collaboration and diagnose full‑stack issues. Experience with the full project lifecycle, from idea inception and stakeholder engagement to monitoring in production. Ready to Ride? This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
